top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation turns ubiquitin-proteasome chemistry into a reproducible, mechanistically defined design principle that many independent groups have used on many targets. Handa's cereblon identification is a measured molecular explanation of why thalidomide-type drugs act, validated the principle in patients before PROTACs existed, and links the glue and PROTAC branches, so P003 is defensible in both. P001 (Ciulli as third) is a close second and clearly preferable to C-N coupling or no award; P002 is mature and verifiable but extends an already recognised cross-coupling logic.
